caption: The same two words in two encodings. One-hot puts their 1s in different positions, so the dot product is 0 and the cosine is 0; the dense vectors give dot 0.56 and cosine ≈ 0.94.

spec.title: One-hot vs dense for cricket and bat
spec.aria: Flow from the words cricket and bat to their one-hot vectors [1,0,0] and [0,1,0], which give cosine 0, and to their dense vectors [0.8,0.2] and [0.6,0.4], which give cosine about 0.94.
